ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, on the left is the larger square PQRS, and on the right a smaller square TUVR is attached, where R is the lower-left corner of the right square and is at the lower-right corner of the large square, and T is on the right side of the large square. Farther to the upper right, square UWXY is attached, and in the diagram P, T, X are on the same oblique straight line. Then reason: It is known that the area of square PQRS is 36, so its side length is 6; the area of square TUVR is 16, so its side length is 4. Set coordinates according to the method: R=(0,0), T=(0,4), U=(4,4), V=(4,0), and the upper-left corner of the large square P=(-6,6). Let the side length of the small square UWXY be s, then X=(4+s,4-s). Because P, T, X are collinear, the slopes are equal. The slope of PT=(4-6)/(0-(-6))=-2/6=-1/3; the slope of TX=((4-s)-4)/((4+s)-0)=-s/(4+s). Let -s/(4+s)=-1/3, obtaining 3s=4+s, so 2s=4, s=2. Therefore X=(6,2). Now find the area of triangle PXV, P=(-6,6), X=(6,2), V=(4,0). Using the determinant formula: area = 1/2 | -6(2-0)+6(0-6)+4(6-2) | = 1/2 | -12-36+16 | = 1/2·32 = 16.

method.method_draft: Use similar triangles to find the small square, then an enclosing-rectangle subtraction for the area. From the image, the top of the 4-by-4 square TUVR sits 2 units below the top of the 6-by-6 square PQRS, so along the line from P to T the horizontal run is 6 and the vertical drop is 2. Let the small square UWXY have side s. From T to X, the horizontal run is the width of TUVR plus the side of the small square, 4+s, and the vertical drop is s. Because P, T, and X are collinear, the two right-triangle slope ratios match: 2/6 = s/(4+s), so s=2. Now place P as the top-left corner of a helper rectangle: in right-and-down coordinates, P=(0,0), X=(12,4), and V=(10,6). The triangle PXV lies inside the 12-by-6 rectangle. Subtract the three outside right triangles: above PX has area 1/2·12·4=24, to the right of XV has area 1/2·2·2=2, and below PV has area 1/2·10·6=30. The rectangle area is 72, so triangle PXV has area 72-24-2-30=16.
